skinwalker/skinwalker_ability_scores.jso.description: Skinwalkers are attuned to the natural order and value passion above reason. Their bestial forms strengthen their bodies in various ways.
skinwalker/skinwalker_ability_scores.jso.name: +2 Wisdom, -2 Intelligence, +2 to One Physical Ability Score While in Bestial Form

skinwalker/skinwalker_animal_minded.json.description: Skinwalkers have a +2 racial bonus on Handle Animal checks and on wild empathy checks.
skinwalker/skinwalker_animal_minded.json.name: Animal-Minded

skinwalker/skinwalker_change_shape.json.description: A skinwalker can change shape to a bestial form as a standard action. In bestial form, a skinwalker gains a +2 racial bonus to his choice of Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. While in this form, a skinwalker also takes on an animalistic feature that provides a special effect. Each time a skinwalker assumes bestial form, he can choose to gain two claw attacks that each deal 1d4 points of damage, 60 foot darkvision, or a +1 natural armor bonus. These benefits last until the skinwalker returns to his humanoid form as a swift action. A skinwalker must first return to his humanoid form before changing to bestial form again to change benefits.
skinwalker/skinwalker_change_shape.json.name: Change Shape

skinwalker/skinwalker_languages.json.description: Skinwalkers all begin play speaking Common. Skinwalkers with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want (except secret languages, such as Druidic).
skinwalker/skinwalker_languages.json.name: Languages

skinwalker/skinwalker_size.json.description: Skinwalkers are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
skinwalker/skinwalker_size.json.name: Medium

skinwalker/skinwalker_speed.json.description: Skinwalkers have a base speed of 30 feet.
skinwalker/skinwalker_speed.json.name: Normal Speed

skinwalker/skinwalker_spell_like_ability.description: A skinwalker with a Wisdom score of 11 or higher can use speak with animals once per day as a spell-like ability, using his Wisdom modifier to determine his concentration checks. The caster level for this ability is equal to the skinwalker's character level.
skinwalker/skinwalker_spell_like_ability.name: Spell-Like Ability

skinwalker/skinwalker_type.json.description: Skinwalkers are humanoids with the shapechanger and skinwalker subtypes. A shapechanger is automatically proficient with simple weapons.
skinwalker/skinwalker_type.json.name: Shapechanger

skinwalker/skinwalker_vision.json.description: Skinwalkers can see twice as far as humans can in dim light.
skinwalker/skinwalker_vision.json.name: Low-Light Vision

skinwalker/skinwalker_werebat_kin.json.description: These skinwalkers are usually communal and defer readily to their superiors. They prefer dwelling in areas of dense foliage, such as jungles or forests. They often have little trust for those not in their immediate clan.
skinwalker/skinwalker_werebat_kin.json.name: Werebat-Kin (Bloodmarked)

skinwalker/skinwalker_wereraptor_kin.jso.description: Skinwalkers descended from wereraptors, aerieborn lack beaks, but have feathers in their bestial form.
skinwalker/skinwalker_wereraptor_kin.jso.name: Wereraptor-Kin (Aerieborn)

skinwalker/skinwalker_wererat_kin.json.description: These creatures, who are among the more common of the skinwalkers, prefer to dwell in urban areas.
skinwalker/skinwalker_wererat_kin.json.name: Wererat-Kin (Nightskulk)

skinwalker/skinwalker_wereshark_kin.json.description: These unusual skinwalkers tend to be strong-willed and brisk in their patterns of speech. They often serve aboard pirate ships, where their traits are well appreciated.
skinwalker/skinwalker_wereshark_kin.json.name: Wereshark-Kin (Seascarred)

skinwalker/skinwalker_werewolf_kin.json.description: Perhaps the most prevalent breed of skinwalker, witchwolves prefer dwelling with others of their kind.
skinwalker/skinwalker_werewolf_kin.json.name: Werewolf-Kin (Witchwolf)
